title: Q3 激励在稀缺工况下的替代性
summary: R1 re-solves the pure-truck and hybrid models at a 0.1% MIP gap for K=5/10/20; K=0 (LP) and K=2 stay at 1% as instructed. At the tight gap the pure-truck unmet is 0.0 / 0.19 / 0.0 at K=5/10/20, so the R0 non-monotonicity (0 / 64.4 / 95.0) was almost entirely 1% gap noise; K=2 keeps a real 134.8 unmet (achieved gap 0.45%) and remains the only scarce-but-servable point. All eight source x budget policies were re-solved at 0.1% for the three tight K (24 new rows, 40 coarse rows kept). The best policy at every K is arrivals B=30000: diff -31,739.2 (K=0), -31,058.7 (K=2, removes 112.02 unmet at 267.8 CNY each), -31,588.8 (K=5), -31,623.3 (K=10), -31,528.8 (K=20). At K=5/20 the best policy removes no zone-level unmet (it adds 22.8); at K=10 it removes 0.19. The payment ceiling pure_obj - hybrid_truck_obj is negative at every K: -1,739.2 (K=0), -1,058.7 (K=2), -1,588.8 (K=5), -1,623.3 (K=10), -1,528.8 (K=20); at the tight-gap K the magnitude is 11-15 times the 0.1% tolerance, so the ceiling is 0 or negative within solver tolerance, not a gap artifact. The conclusion is unchanged and now gap-robust: within K in [0,20] the incentive never pays for itself; its value is design and budget discipline.

notes: The R0 non-monotonicity was 1% gap noise: K=10's 64.4 and K=20's 95.0 unmet become 0.19 and 0.0 at 0.1%. K=5 was already 0 at 1%. K=0 (LP) and K=2 were kept at 1% per the review; K=2's achieved gap was 0.45%, so its 134.8 unmet is not a gap artifact.

The R0 payment ceiling -686.58 is withdrawn. R1 ceilings are -1,739.2 (K=0), -1,058.7 (K=2), -1,588.8 (K=5), -1,623.3 (K=10), -1,528.8 (K=20). At the tight-gap K the magnitude (1,529-1,623) is 11-15x the 0.1% tolerance (111-134), so the negative sign is not solver noise.

At K=5 and K=20 the best policy by total cost removes no zone-level unmet (it adds 22.8 because the IPF-refitted PZ moves arrivals into zone-hours that are already long). It is still the least-bad policy because its payment is the smallest. At K=10 the best policy removes 0.19.

Mechanism diagnostics remain from the 1% plans (unchanged plans, K=2 same caliber): aligned_share 0.1589 at K=2, 1,405 of 28,885 reroutes cross zones (4.9%), about 258 reroutes per removed unmet trip. The K=10/20 price-mismatch figures in R0 (315.8 CNY) are withdrawn with the gap artifact; the K=2 267.8 CNY figure stands.

64 hybrid rows: 40 coarse (all 7 K in {0,2,5,10,20,40,60} x 8 policies, as R0) plus 24 tight (K=5/10/20 x 8). Rows carry gap_mode and gap; the tight rows use the pure-truck 0.1% objective as the baseline, the coarse rows the 1% objective.
